items.text:
Can I recommend this game? For someone who has never tried it before? No. It is Early Access with a big E and a big A. Have I spent a lot of time playtesting this game? Yes. Do I regret having spent money on it? Yes. Has it drastically changed since the early pitch in 2020? Yes. Is it what it says on the tin? Depends on who you are, but for me and any of the demographics of people I work with, no.

If Dominique Tipper's endorsement of this game brought you, a queer fan of the Expanse TV show here, I can tell you that the moderation of the community takes white cishet feelings very seriously and will harshly punish you for making fun of nose ring theory,, equating it with homophobic bigotry while also wanting your money for their game that lets you make a character in which you can select between three exclusive sets of pronouns and your characters sexuality is based on any combition of these three pronouns. If you decide to date a rich person as a woman during character creation, you will for some screwed up reason be given zero money and gain great skills in dancing and cooking and sometimes scars. If you know why this is problematic, you know, if you don't, well go ahead and tell me how horrible i am and how much you care about telling me how little you care.

I dont know what is happening here but I am going to assume the developer, in its growth and the changing of hands in terms of publishers has turned into well-meaning but ill-reflected and poorly acting group of very privileged people.

In other words, if you belong to multiple marginalized groups, do not expect, in spite of what the games marketing and general flairs indicate, that you are safe in the community, it is ran by white cishet people and mainly intended for the overwhelming majority demographic of english language fictional media.
items.text_zh:
我能推荐这款游戏吗？对于一个从未尝试过它的人？不能。它是抢先体验版，带着一个大大的“抢”和“先”。我在这款游戏上花了很多时间进行游戏测试吗？是的。我后悔在它上面花钱吗？是的。自2020年早期宣传以来，它发生了巨大变化吗？是的。它是否名副其实？取决于你是谁，但对我以及与我共事的任何人群来说，不是。

如果多米尼克·蒂珀对这款游戏的背书把你带到了这里，一个《苍穹浩瀚》电视剧的酷儿粉丝，我可以告诉你，社区的版主非常认真地对待白人顺性别异性恋者的感受，并且会因为你拿鼻环理论开玩笑而严厉惩罚你，将其等同于恐同偏执，同时还想要你为他们的游戏花钱，这个游戏让你创建一个角色，你可以在三套专属代词之间选择，而你的角色性取向基于这三个代词的任意组合。如果你在角色创建时决定以女性身份和一个富人约会，你会因为某种糟糕的原因得到零金钱，并获得舞蹈和烹饪方面的出色技能，有时还有伤疤。如果你知道为什么这是有问题的，你知道，如果你不知道，那就继续告诉我我有多糟糕，以及你有多在乎告诉我你有多不在乎。

我不知道这里发生了什么，但我将假设开发商在其成长和发行商易手的过程中，变成了一个善意但缺乏反思、行为糟糕、非常享有特权的群体。

换句话说，如果你属于多个边缘化群体，不要指望——尽管游戏的营销和一般风格表明如此——你在社区中是安全的，它由白人顺性别异性恋者运营，主要面向英语虚构媒体的压倒性多数人群。

observations.description: 社区管理对白人顺性别异性恋感受过于敏感，会严厉惩罚开玩笑的玩家
